QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] What Hirrel Knows
QuestInfo.0: Parma doesn't know the king's whereabouts. But she says Hirrel the clerk should know where the king went on that last day.
QuestInfo.1: You meet Hirrel the clerk to learn of the king's last destination. He says the king traveled to a top secret area that was confidential to everyone. Apparently General Blundell has been there before.
QuestInfo.2: You met Hirrel the clerk. He said General Blundell has been to the top secret area before.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0#  53,237,287
Can proceed to [Kritias] What Blundell Knows

0.0: The disappearance of His Majesty is a serious matter even for Kritias. But with security in this state, a search is out of the question. All General Blundell can do is defend. And we can't even get close to that Trueffet... \r\n#L0# #bHis Majesty that day...#l\n#k
0.1: On the day of the tragedy, His Majesty Hekaton visited the top secret area below Kritias. \r\n#L0# #bThere was a top secret area?#l\n#k
0.2: Even if someone learned of it, they'd never speak of it. His Majesty is compassionate, but he strictly forbid speaking about the mere existence of that area.\r\n#L0# #bAnd... he disappeared.#l\n#k
0.3: Yes, I'm talking right now because of that. His Majesty disappeared after going to the place and Kritias reappeared after disappearing for centuries. We fear he may died there.\r\n#L0# #bWhat place is that top secret area?#l\n#k
0.4: Something is in that place. Something that caused all of this. It might be that from that day...\r\n#L0# #bHas anyone been there before?#l\n#k
0.5: Well... yes. \rThere is just one person.

yes.0: It's General Blundell. He took... #bsomething#k to the top secret area after that day. Not once has he talked about it, but we know he did so.
yes.1: General Blundell should have more to say about that #bsomething#k.

1.0: Oh, good to see you. We were in short of defense but...

yes.0: Hm? Top secret area? How do you know that?

default.0: Blundell is in the Northern Barracks. Go see him.
